description: Sync engine + completed-session immutability enforcement + conflict resolution (design C.16 step 10, C.7). Adds the user-visible sync layer, the decomposed composite 'complete session' operation with the offline flush barrier and the separate idempotent summary transactions, and the three-way completed-session immutability (rules already in FEAT-001; here the service + conflict-resolver layers). Depends on FEAT-003 (session engine, PR engine, exerciseHistory) because completion orchestrates those writes.
steps: Read context.json and this FEAT FIRST. Implement src/lib/sync/{networkStatus,syncQueue,conflictResolver,syncManager}.ts, src/store/syncStore.ts, src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts, and src/components/sync/SyncStatus.tsx. Enforce the queue-authority boundary (C.7): single-doc idempotent writes (SetLog create/update, recoveryLogs/{date}, bodyMeasurements, notes, hydration, goals, settings/profile) go DIRECTLY through the Firestore SDK with deterministic ids and are NEVER enqueued; the custom syncQueue owns ONLY the composite 'complete session' op (orchestration/status, not transport).

Implement the decomposed completion in sessionService/syncManager: Step 1 PR detection reads bounded exerciseHistory BEFORE any write (no transaction). Step 2 is a single writeBatch (status=COMPLETED + totals; flip sessionCompleted=true on each ExerciseSession and SetLog; create personalRecords with deterministic ids ${sessionId}_${exerciseId}_${type}; upsert exerciseHistory rollups) and is GATED on `await waitForPendingWrites(db)` so the COMPLETED flip is strictly last (flush barrier, HIGH-1); hold the completion op while navigator.onLine is false and start the barrier only on reconnect. Document the <=100-sets guard / ~73-write worst case under the 500 batch limit.

Implement Step 3 as a SEPARATE runTransaction per weekly (analyticsWeekly/{yyyy-'W'II}) and monthly (analyticsMonthly/{yyyy-MM}) summary doc: read the session doc first; if summaryApplied===true return a no-op; else add the session deltas to the summary and flip summaryApplied=true on the session in the SAME transaction via a MERGE updateDoc (preserving all session fields so validSession passes post-merge; HIGH-2); the toggle carries NO baseUpdatedAt precondition. A second-device race that is rules-denied because stored summaryApplied is already true is treated by syncManager as SUCCESS (goal met), not a retryable error (MEDIUM-3). Step 2 must succeed before Step 3 is enqueued; Step 3 retries independently.

Implement conflictResolver + the service-layer defense-in-depth for completed-session immutability: server updatedAt wins for mutable docs; last-writer-wins per field only within baseUpdatedAt-guarded transactions; the resolver and the services DROP/refuse any op that writes to, appends a child to, or deletes a COMPLETED session (FR-39). SyncOperation.id dedupes composite replays; deterministic doc ids dedupe component docs (AC-10).
Run verification, fix failures, set FEAT status completed, record findings (which immutability/no-duplicate assertions still need the emulator), commit locally (no push).
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build exit 0 with empty env.
A Vitest shows conflictResolver drops ops targeting a COMPLETED session, Step 3 is a no-op when summaryApplied===true, and the completion write-set stays within the documented bound (<=~73, <500).
The completion op gates Step 2 on waitForPendingWrites(db) and holds while offline (code path present and unit-exercised with a stubbed db).
SyncOperation.id dedupes a replayed composite op and deterministic ids dedupe component writes (unit-asserted).
verification: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build  (exit 0, empty env)
pnpm vitest run src/lib/sync  (conflictResolver immutability drop, Step3 no-op, write-set bound, dedupe)

pnpm test:rules IF the Firebase Emulator Suite is available: assert C.14 (a)-(g) incl. COMPLETED durationSeconds-update denied while summaryApplied toggle allowed, COMPLETED delete denied, create under COMPLETED denied, frozen SetLog update denied (AC-4/AC-11); otherwise record these and the live reconnect-no-duplicates run (AC-10) as 'needs verification during implementation'.
findings:
FEAT-004 complete. All gates green with EMPTY .env.local: pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm typecheck (tsc --noEmit), pnpm build (next build; 15 routes, next-pwa SW generated, nothing throws at import/build), and 116 Vitest tests pass (31 new; prior 85 still green). No Firebase was mocked to fake success.

FILES ADDED. src/lib/sync/networkStatus.ts (SSR/test-safe isOnline + subscribeNetworkStatus over navigator.onLine). src/lib/sync/syncQueue.ts (PURE queue ops over SyncOperation[]: enqueue DEDUPES by SyncOperation.id, dequeue/peek FIFO by createdAtMs, recordFailure, exponential backoffMs cap 60s, MAX_ATTEMPTS=8, deterministic completeSessionOpId/summaryOpId). src/lib/sync/conflictResolver.ts (PURE: resolveSessionOp DROPS mutate/delete/append on a COMPLETED session, ALLOWS the summaryApplied false->true toggle, DROPS the toggle as 'summary-already-applied' when the stored pre-image is already true [MEDIUM-3]; resolveLastWriterWins server-wins-on-tie; baseGuardSatisfied). src/lib/sync/syncManager.ts (flushCompleteSession: conflict/immutability guard first; HOLDS while offline [belt-and-suspenders]; gates Step 2 on await waitForPendingWrites(db) so the COMPLETED flip is strictly LAST [HIGH-1]; Step 3 runs only AFTER Step 2; completionWriteCount/completionWithinBatchLimit document the ~73-write worst case + the <=100-set guard under the 500 batch limit; step runners + barrier + online injectable for unit tests). src/lib/sync/summaryKeys.ts (weekIdOf yyyy-'W'II via date-fns RRRR-WII, monthIdOf yyyy-MM, SessionSummaryDelta). src/store/syncStore.ts (persist; one of the three persisted stores; holds ONLY the composite queue + visible phase/online/lastSynced). src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts, src/components/sync/SyncStatus.tsx (status pill).

FILES CHANGED. src/services/analyticsService.ts: real getWeekly/getMonthly reads + applySessionSummaries — a SEPARATE runTransaction (decoupled from the Step-2 batch) that reads the session doc FIRST, is a no-op if summaryApplied===true, else adds the weekly+monthly deltas and flips summaryApplied=true via a MERGE updateDoc in the SAME transaction (preserves all training fields so validSession passes post-merge, HIGH-2; the flag flips ONCE after BOTH periods, so a replay reads true and no-ops). shouldApplySummary() extracted PURE for unit test. src/services/syncService.ts: replaced the FEAT-001 flushPending stub with buildCompleteSessionOp + runCompleteSession (public entry composing the pure syncManager with the guarded db). src/lib/firebase/firestore.ts: weeklySummaryDocRef/monthlySummaryDocRef (analyticsWeekly/analyticsMonthly per C.4). src/lib/firebase/converters.ts: weeklySummaryConverter/monthlySummaryConverter. src/services/services.test.ts: updated the sync short-circuit assertion to runCompleteSession.

QUEUE-AUTHORITY BOUNDARY (C.7) honored: the custom syncQueue/syncStore owns ONLY the composite completeSession op (orchestration/status, not transport). Single-doc idempotent writes (SetLog logSet, recoveryLogs/{date}, bodyMeasurements, notes, hydration, goals, settings/profile) remain DIRECT SDK writes with deterministic ids in their own services and are never enqueued here. SyncOperation.id dedupes composite replays (unit-asserted); deterministic doc ids (session/exercise/set/PR via ${sessionId}_${exerciseId}_${type}, history by exerciseId) dedupe component writes so a re-issued batch overwrites (AC-10).

TESTS. pnpm vitest run src/lib/sync (31 tests, 4 files): conflictResolver immutability drops + LWW + base guard; syncQueue dedupe/FIFO/backoff/retry; syncManager barrier-before-step2 ordering, offline hold (barrier never started), Step2-fail-skips-Step3, Step3 noop treated as DONE, drop-when-server-COMPLETED, write-set bound (73<500) + 100-set guard; summary Step-3 no-op decision + period keys. sessionService.completeSession + markSummaryApplied (the waitForPendingWrites barrier + merge toggle) were already in place from FEAT-003 and are driven by syncManager here.

NEEDS VERIFICATION DURING IMPLEMENTATION (no Firebase creds + emulator unavailable in sandbox; do NOT claim done without them): (1) AC-11 / C.14 (b)-(e) rules assertions — COMPLETED durationSeconds-update denied, COMPLETED delete denied, create-under-COMPLETED (parentOpen get) denied, frozen SetLog update denied, and summaryApplied toggle allowed — are written in tests/rules/firestore.rules.test.ts and pass as SELF-SKIPPED no-ops (initializeTestEnvironment throws without the emulator). Run `pnpm test:rules` against a running Firebase Emulator Suite (firestore on 127.0.0.1:8080) to actually exercise them. (2) AC-10 live reconnect-no-duplicates: the waitForPendingWrites barrier ordering and deterministic-id idempotency are unit-exercised with stubbed db/injected steps, but the real cross-process reconnect flush ordering (a late SetLog create must not hit a COMPLETED parent) can only be proven against the emulator or live creds. (3) The syncStore->syncManager live driver loop (dequeue on done/dropped, backoff-retry on retry, benign summary-denial->success) is implemented at the function level; wiring an app-level flush trigger on reconnect is a later integration step and benefits from emulator verification.
